question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is '**comprehension**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the third blank 'comprehension' should be used.
 
• The reason for choosing "**comprehension**" as the correct answer for blank number 3 is that the sentence talks about how performing a task or activity regularly or constantly helps in building expertise in that area and gaining a better understanding or **comprehension** of it.
 
• **Comprehension** refers to the ability to understand something. In the context of the given sentence, consistency helps in enhancing the comprehension or understanding of a particular task or activity. This is because consistent effort over a longer period of time helps in gaining a deeper understanding of the nuances of the task or activity, which is not possible through sporadic or occasional efforts.
 
• Let's look at the **meaning **of other words:
 
 
• **Decision** - A choice or resolution made after consideration or deliberation. (निर्णय)
 
• **Comprehension** - The ability to understand something. (समझ)
 
• **Estrangement** - The act of being alienated or removed from something. (अलगाव)
 
• **Ignorance** - Lack of knowledge or information. (अज्ञान)
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 2.**

 

Correct Passage:__ *Being constant (1) __entails__ repeating a task or action, or performing an activity without a stop or interval. Consistency can never be attained in a sporadic or (2) __intermittent__ manner. When you perform anything regularly or constantly, you will not only build expertise in that area, but you will also gain a better** (3)** __**comprehension**__* *of it. Because of the greater amount of effort put in over a longer period of time, this enhanced comprehension is (4) _______. As a result, consistency is the (5) _______ that allows anyone to consistently put in the effort.*
